card.name: Digits inside numbers and tables
card.fires_on: Fires on a digit (often 0, 3 or 5) in the middle of a longer number, such as a code, table value or decimal. Also fires on the word "three" in the spelled-out number "Two thousand three hundred twenty-one".

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: A single digit partway through a code, table value or decimal.

modes.label: Spelled-out three
modes.description: The word three in "Two thousand three hundred twenty-one" in a hormone-therapy trial passage.
modes.example: Two thousand<< three>> hundred and twenty one women from the original

card.plain: It lights up on a number's middle digits, or on the word "three" in one spelled-out trial count.
